text:
noah_sales: FYI PeregrineBio wants a 6-week POC for their peregrine-35b-utf8-mixq variant. Needs: p50 <200ms at 4k context, KV-prefix caching, HIPAA/BAA, EU data residency. Prefer Dedicated but open to Private if needed. Can we do quick catalog + onboarding effort + POC price sketch?

dina_se: On it. Two immediate checks: tokenizer differences and whether mixq uses any nonstandard quant layout. Ask for sample prompts and vocab if they can.

noah_sales: They uploaded 80 sample prompts and a tokenizer diff file. Says variant is "mixq-int8-kv" and theres a few custom special tokens for lab values.

dina_se: Running local verify:
```
redwood verify --model peregrine-35b --variant mixq-int8-kv --tokenizer peregrine-utf8 --samples ./peregrine_prompts.json
```
Prelim results: kv-cache OK, quant path needs micro-bench, tokenizer: special tokens mapped -> small adapter (2-4hrs).

mike_infra: Perf note: 4k context at p50 <200ms is achievable on Dedicated with H100-class instances + aggressive prefix cache. For HIPAA we need BAA + logging; Hosted not acceptable. For EU residency choose eu-central Dedicated or Private.

mike_infra: Rough POC pricing (6 weeks, ~300k tokens/day): Dedicated (eu-central, reserve): ~$9k total with POC discount. Private/on-prem: ~$28k install + support (customer infra not included).

zara_security: HIPAA/BAA + EU residency = must collect compliance contact, required DPA terms, and encryption at rest (customer-managed keys preferred). If they insist on our managed FIPS HSM we need legal review. Also confirm retention and deletion SLAs.

dina_se: Engineering estimate: adapter + tests ~3hrs, PR + bench ~1 day. Once adapter merged, tag @mike_infra for micro-bench.

ops-bot: micro-bench queued (job id: mb-44321). Will post results here.

noah_sales: Action list: (1) I'll get their compliance contact and confirm BAA + retention needs, (2) ask whether Dedicated with BYO-KMS is acceptable or they require Private, (3) share prompt corpus with Dina.

dina_se: If micro-bench shows perf headroom call out that <150ms would need 2x baseline instances.

mike_infra: Noted. I'll draft a short Dedicated sizing + pricing note and share in 24h.

zara_security: I'll draft a one-page compliance checklist (BAA, encryption, SSO, audit logs) and send to Noah in 48h.

noah_sales: Thanks team. I'll update Peregrine and loop legal after Zaras checklist. :+1:
